docTitle: CRE Northstar Demo Brokerage Brings 48-Unit Hillcrest Gardens Apartments to Market in Mission Valley
subtitle: The $10.95 million offering adds rare mark-to-market multifamily inventory to one of San Diego's most supply-constrained submarkets.

paragraphs: San Diego, CA (July 14, 2026) – CRE Northstar (demo) today announced the exclusive listing of Hillcrest Gardens Apartments, a 48-unit multifamily community at 4180 Terrace Crest Dr in Mission Valley, offered at $10,950,000.
The offering represents a 6.33 percent capitalization rate on trailing net operating income of $692,800, with occupancy of 93.6 percent through the trailing twelve months.
Built in 1987, the community comprises 28 one-bedroom and 20 two-bedroom units across 41,280 rentable square feet, with in-place rents approximately 8 percent below market.

paragraphs: [DRAFT QUOTE — approve or edit] "Mission Valley rarely offers mark-to-market inventory at this scale, and the rent roll tells the whole story," said Principal, Julie Chasen.
Offers are due August 14, 2026. The offering memorandum is available to qualified investors upon execution of a confidentiality agreement.
